Information worth preparing

A concise brief helps make the first conversation specific without submitting data on this website.

  • The business and audience the website should serve
  • The main action visitors should be able to take
  • Current website details, if an existing site is involved
  • Pages, content and media already available
  • Required functions or external systems to investigate
  • Who will review content and make project decisions
  • Hosting, editing and maintenance expectations
  • Any accessibility or browser requirements already known

No information is submitted here
